summary: A recycler has a warehouse full of returned bottles just as textile customers stop buying the material.
realLife: The Missourian reported that Columbia's ordinance took effect during a textile downturn. Dave Allen accumulated plastic he had agreed to buy from local stores.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: returned stock and actual purchase orders.

turns.what: A forklift operator makes room for the next store pickup.
turns.pulledBy: A textile buyer confirms a shipment.
turns.writesBack: The recycler releases the corresponding warehouse stock.

turns.what: The recycler calls stores that expect a pickup before accepting another load.
turns.pulledBy: Orders dry up while returns keep arriving.
turns.writesBack: The warehouse fills even as stores keep paying refunds.
